usedFor: Shopify holds checkouts, and Saleshandy holds prospects, so “Abandoned Checkout” can tag one with “Assign Prospect Tag”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Assign Prospect Tag” in Saleshandy
bestTemplate.why: The shopper's email identifies the prospect, so the tag lands on the right person.

watchOut: “Assign Prospect Tag” identifies the prospect by email, so that field must be mapped.
